column1: # *** AVELINO'S DATES ARE THE BIGGEST GAIN. *** Born 1815 and dead on 22 August 1890 - so he was
# alive when his son Alfredo Justiniano was baptised in 1858 and dead before Alfredo married in 1892,
# which is why AMBROSIA TRAIBEL stood witness at that wedding rather than her husband. Three records
# now lock together.
# *** AND JUSTA PASTORA'S MARRIAGE IS DATED: 3 NOVEMBER 1830, at the CORDON. *** Her first child was
# baptised at the same parish on 13 December 1831 - the act at which FRUCTUOSO RIVERA, President of
# the Republic, stood godfather. Thirteen months between the wedding and that font.
# ================ A CAUTION ON DOMINGA, RECORDED RATHER THAN RESOLVED ================
# Two records name a DOMINGA, daughter of Sancho and Maria Fernandez, with DIFFERENT HUSBANDS:
#   - "Dominga Lorena ... Parents D. Sancho Lerena, Maria Fernandez ... Spouses ANTONIO RODRIGUEZ,
#      Children Domingo"            ark 1:1:6D7C-5X1Y / image 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-YSFY-L
#   - "Dominga Llarena ... Parents Maria Fernandez, Sancho Llerena ... Spouses ANTONIO RUIZ DE
#      CARVALLO, Children Lucinda Gregoria del Corazon de Jesus"
#                                   ark 1:1:6DF7-HZPR / image 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-YSFQ-2
# The image arks are adjacent, so these are near neighbours in one register. *** THAT IS EITHER ONE
# WOMAN WHO MARRIED TWICE, ONE MAN WHOSE NAME IS WRITTEN TWO WAYS, OR TWO SISTERS OF THE SAME NAME -
# and this archive has been caught by exactly this shape twice already, *** with the two Arturos and
# the three Josefas. Both husbands are ANTONIO, which is suggestive of one man and no proof of it.
# NOT MERGED. Both images need opening.
